newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Slavneft oil units to use single registrar.
newsitem.headline: Russian Slavneft oil units to use single registrar.

text.p: Russia's NGK Slavneft oil holding company and all its units will use a single share registrar, a spokesman for Slavneft said on Tuesday.
AO Servis-reyestr, the registrar, has already taken responsibility for Slavneft's main production unit Megionneftegaz, Slavneft itself and Megionneftegazgeologiya, the spokesman said.
It will soon sign agreements with some other Slavneft units, the spokesman said.

Servis-reyestr, controlled by Megatrastoil, a financial consultant to Megionneftegaz, took over registers for AO Slavneft-Yaroslavsky's Mendeleyev oil refinery and Slavneft-Yaroslavnefteprodukt in 1996.
Previously the central share depositary for the Yaroslavl region had acted as registrar for Slavneft units in the area.
